title: Connected accounts
lede: Connect Gmail so outreach goes out from your own address, and forward replies here so every conversation keeps moving.

gmail.title: Gmail
gmail.body: When you approve an outreach email, Onward Scout sends it from your Gmail — written for that one person, never in bulk. Without Gmail, you get the same email ready to send from your own mail app.
gmail.errorBody: Google stopped letting us send for you, usually because access was removed in your Google Account. Connect again to keep sending.
gmail.unavailableBody: Sending through Gmail isn't switched on for Onward Scout yet. Until it is, every email we prepare opens in your own mail app, ready to send.
gmail.disconnected: Gmail disconnected. We can no longer send from it.
gmail.testSent: Test email sent to {email}. Check your inbox.
gmail.sentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No emails sent through Gmail yet} one {# email sent through Gmail} other {# emails sent through Gmail}}

flash.connected: Gmail connected. Emails you approve now go out from your address.
flash.denied: Gmail wasn't connected because Google's permission screen was closed. Nothing changed.
flash.scope: Google didn't grant permission to send email, so Gmail isn't connected. Tick “Send email on your behalf” when you try again.
flash.expired: That connection attempt expired. Please try again.
flash.error: We couldn't connect Gmail just now. Please try again in a minute.

scope.title: What Onward Scout can and can't do
scope.send: Send the emails you approve, from your address, one recipient at a time.
scope.identity: See which email address it sends from.
scope.noRead: It can't read, search, label or delete anything in your mailbox. We never ask for that permission.
scope.noBulk: No bulk mail: at most {perDay} new conversations a day, never the same person twice within {days} days, and anyone who asks us to stop is never emailed again.
scope.revoke: Disconnect here at any time, or remove access in your Google Account under Security → Your connections to third-party apps.

dropbox.title: Reply drop-box
dropbox.body: Got a reply? Forward it to your personal address. We attach it to the right application, tell you what it means — interested, a meeting, a no, a question — and stop follow-ups to that person.
dropbox.unavailable: Your drop-box address appears here once your account is set up. Reload the page in a moment.
dropbox.auto1: In Gmail, open Settings → Forwarding and POP/IMAP → Add a forwarding address, and paste your drop-box address.
dropbox.auto2: Google sends a confirmation code to that address. It appears in your Onward Scout notifications within a minute; enter it in Gmail.
dropbox.auto3: Create a filter for the people you've written to and choose “Forward it to” your drop-box address.
dropbox.privacy: Only what you forward reaches us. We read it to file and classify the reply, nothing else.

errors.sendFailed: The test email didn't go out. Please try again.
